message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on any incoming data or arguments anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected untrusted source handling: The download_weights() function fetches a zip from a hardcoded URL using requests without any checksum verification, signature check, or pinned revision to validate integrity.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution checks, label value validation, or label-noise detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are used anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code applies only standard augmentation transforms (RandomCrop, RandomHorizontalFlip, Normalize) with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained weights via `BYOL_Pre.load_from_checkpoint(pre_file, ...)` and `models.resnet18(pretrained=...)` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to confirm integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, Cleverhans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: The test_step in Classifier is a no-op (pass), the test call in train.py is commented out, and there is no isolation of a held-out test set or hashing/signing of evaluation data.
No detected input sanitization: The inference/data path applies only standard normalization transforms (T.Normalize) with no shape, range, or schema validation of incoming inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (logits/predictions) are used directly with cross_entropy and Accuracy without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision classification model (ResNet/CIFAR10), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
